reply: Great. The track will add the three chapter 13 topics, keep Ohm's law and resistors in series and in parallel as revision at about 2 questions an exam, and aim for 8 / 10 or better in 3 exams in a row, with progress starting again at 0. Please press "Start the track again" to apply it.

newTopics.name: Magnetic field and field lines
newTopics.description: Magnetic field around a bar magnet, compass deflection, field lines from north to south pole outside and south to north inside, field lines never cross, closer lines mean a stronger field.

newTopics.name: Magnetic field around a straight current-carrying wire
newTopics.description: Concentric circular field lines around a straight wire, field stronger nearer the wire and with larger current, and the right-hand thumb rule for field direction.

newTopics.name: Solenoid and electromagnet
newTopics.description: A long coil of many turns with a nearly uniform field inside like a bar magnet; a soft iron core makes an electromagnet that is magnetic only while current flows.
